text: I can highly recommend Dr. Alex. His spoken English is very good, and before starting he will explain what will be happening during your appointment. He is gentle and above all, his work is concise and meticulous. The assistants are also very kind and polite. After numerous appointments, I can say that my personal experience here has been excellent.

I had an amazing experience at Dental Clinic Samui! From the moment I walked in, the staff was friendly, professional, and made me feel completely at ease. But the real highlight was Dr. Alex — hands down the best dental doctor I’ve ever had.

He was incredibly gentle, patient, and explained everything clearly, making the whole process stress-free. You can tell he truly cares about his patients and takes pride in his work. My treatment was painless, efficient, and the results were better than I expected.

If you're in Samui and need dental care, I highly recommend this clinic — and definitely ask for Dr. Alex.

I had a great experience with the doctor. I came in for a crown placement, but after examining my case, the Dr recommended I see a specialist for a more suitable treatment. The staff was friendly, the office was very clean, and I felt well cared for throughout. I’d highly recommend!! 10/10

Great service, most of the staff speak pretty good English so that should not be a worry. charged me 400 baht for 2 x-rays, ibuprofen and antibiotics which i would say is an amazing rate. (was just getting my gum checked out because it was enflamed) super helpful, they’re definitely just looking to do a good job :)

I swallowed my crown from a front tooth so I looked a little bit like a pirate! I won’t be going back to Canada for a while so it had to be replaced! What a great dentist here on Koh Samui! He had all the up to date equipment, put in a nice feeling temporary and sent the moulds off to Bangkok for the final ceramic crown! He put it in with greatest of care and it feels and LOOKS great! His office will call me to come in and he’ll check it in 6 months! BONUS: If I have any issues either like loosing it again within 2 years? It will be replaced for free! And he put the crown on today…,SUNDAY! Talk about dedication! Incredibly professional dentist! 12 out of 10!
